title: Import your Xaman account
description: Step by step: import an existing XRP Ledger account into XRP Mobile using the 8 rows of Xaman secret numbers, set a PIN, and fund the address with the 1 XRP an account needs to activate on the ledger. Same address, same balance, and the keys stay on your phone. Never share your secret numbers with anyone.
lede: Moving from Xaman? You do not need to export anything. Your secret numbers are all it takes.

steps.caption: Tap Import wallet
steps.body: Open XRP Mobile and tap Import wallet. Your account already exists on the XRP Ledger, so we are restoring it, not creating a new one.

steps.caption: Choose Secret numbers
steps.body: Choose Secret numbers. These are the 8 rows of 6 digits Xaman gave you when you backed up your account.

steps.caption: Type your 8 rows
steps.body: Type them in order, from A to H. Take your time here, and never share these numbers with anyone.

steps.caption: Every row is checked
steps.body: Each row carries a checksum, so the app confirms it with a tick as you go. If a row is wrong you will know right away.

steps.caption: Name it and set a PIN
steps.body: Give the account a name, then pick a PIN. The PIN unlocks the app on this phone and never leaves it.

shots.alt: Name it and set a PIN

steps.caption: Your account is back
steps.body: And there it is. Same address, same balance, restored from the same secret numbers Xaman uses.

steps.caption: Fund it to activate
steps.body: A brand new address needs at least 1 XRP to exist on the ledger. Tap Deposit to get yours.

steps.caption: Send XRP to this address
steps.body: Pick XRP, and send at least 1 XRP to this address from any exchange or wallet, over the XRP Ledger network.
